code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PSC::calling_id
       Get or set calling id.

SYNOPSIS
       PSC::calling_id (CALLING_ID)?

DESCRIPTION
       The PSC::calling_id command gets the calling station id or sets the calling station id when the optional value is given.

       Syntax

       PSC::calling_id

	    * Retrieve the calling station id.

       PSC::calling_id 

	    * Set the calling station id.

RETURN VALUE
       Return the calling station id when no argument is given.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.
